maximumWin.title: Maximum Win
maximumWin.body: The highest possible multiplier is 25,000x your bet. This is the absolute ceiling—even if the game continues beyond this point (theoretically), your payout caps at 25,000x.

minimumCashOut.title: Minimum Cash-Out (Free Bets Only)
minimumCashOut.body: When playing with free bets, a minimum cash-out multiplier applies (typically 1.50x, but configurable). You cannot cash out below this threshold when using promotional free bets.

placingBets.title: Placing Bets
placingBets.step1: Choose your bet amount using the +/- buttons or preset values (2.00, 5.00, 10.00, Max)
placingBets.step2: You can place up to two independent bets per round using the left and right betting panels
placingBets.step3: Press BET (purple button) to confirm your wager for the next comet launch
placingBets.step4: You have 6 seconds between rounds to place bets
placingBets.step5: When the comet launches and the multiplier starts rising, betting is locked until the next round

cashingOut.title: Cashing Out
cashingOut.step1: Click CASH OUT at any time during the match to secure your winnings
cashingOut.step3: If you place two bets, each has its own cash-out button
cashingOut.step4: If you fail to cash out before the comet explodes → your bet is lost
cashingOut.step5: After cashing out, wait until the round ends to bet again

provablyFair.howItWorksBody: Our Provably Fair system uses several parameters to ensure complete transparency and fairness. Each round has both hidden and revealed states.
provablyFair.beforeGameBegins: Before the game begins, players can see:
provablyFair.provablyFairHashDescription: – A cryptographic hash that proves the round outcome was predetermined
provablyFair.note: The Server Key and Crash Point remain hidden to ensure fairness.
